component.name: Neo
component.summary: Launch and manage NeoFN builds on Linux

description.p: Neo is a native Linux launcher for NeoFN. It downloads and verifies game builds, manages Proton prefixes and launch options, signs you in, and starts the game — with readable progress and readable errors.

ul.li: Install, import, verify and repair builds
Per-build launch arguments, Proton build and prefix
Account sign-in with no plaintext credential storage
Logs and a redacted diagnostics report you can share safely
Dark and light themes that follow your desktop

screenshot.caption: Neo's Play page, signed in and ready to launch a build

description.p: First tagged release: the desktop app is the default way to use Neo, the command-line tool is an optional install offered on first launch, and a portable AppImage is published alongside the release.
